You will spend four nights in traditional yurts hosted by local Kyrgyz families who spend the summer herding and caring for their sheep, cows, and horses. Immerse yourself in their daily life and shepherd culture to experience the authentic atmosphere of nomadic living and enjoy unforgettable moments of connection with local people.

In the evenings, gather around the fire listening to stories about the mountains, the road, and life on the steppe. During the day, accompany the herds across alpine pastures and experience the natural rhythm of nomadic family life.

Nestled high in the Tien Shan Mountains, Kel-Suu Lake is an alpine wonder renowned for its otherworldly turquoise waters, dramatic cliffs, and serene atmosphere. This remote region is ideal for exploring untouched wilderness, with trails winding through high mountain passes and lush valleys.
tours.text2ndPart: This unforgettable adventure combines thrilling horseback riding with the rich cultural traditions of Kyrgyzstan. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced rider, skilled guides and well-trained horses ensure a safe, comfortable, and truly memorable journey, leaving you with lasting impressions of this remarkable region.

Join our organized trek to Lenin Peak Base Camp in the Pamir-Alay Mountains of southern Kyrgyzstan. You will get remarkably close to one of the region’s most awe-inspiring summits. Spend a night at the Base Camp at an altitude of around 4,400 meters, surrounded by panoramic views of glaciers and towering mountain ranges. Even on its own, this place feels like the top of the world.
tours.text2ndPart: The route also includes an ascent of Yukhin Peak (over 5,130 meters), offering even broader and more spectacular views across the Pamirs. This trek combines a true high-altitude atmosphere, a rewarding physical challenge, and the rare feeling of complete connection with the mountains. It is a journey that truly takes your breath away — both literally and emotionally.

The journey combines road transfers and hiking, while staying in yurts and guesthouses makes it a truly authentic experience. This route is for those who want to see more than just beautiful landscapes — and feel true freedom.

tours.text1stPart: Embark on an exciting journey along the legendary Silk Road — a route that for centuries connected East and West, cultures and civilizations. This unique tour takes you through ancient cities, majestic mountain passes, and scenic valleys of Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, and Kyrgyzstan, revealing the rich historical heritage and natural beauty of Central Asia.
tours.text2ndPart: During the journey, you will experience stunning alpine landscapes, high mountain passes, ancient fortresses, and traditional settlements that preserve the spirit of nomadic culture. A special highlight of the route is a trek through the Pamir-Alay mountains and an encounter with the hospitality of Kyrgyz nomads, including overnight stays in yurts, cultural experiences, and unforgettable views of Lenin Peak.

steps.header: Departure from Osh to Sary-Mogul Village
steps.text: Transfer from Osh to the high-mountain village of Sary-Mogul with a stop for a light hike to Emerald Lake and lunch along the way. Upon arrival, enjoy dinner and relax at a guesthouse overlooking the Pamir Mountains.

steps.header: Trek from Sary-Mogul to Zhanyryk Yurt Camp
steps.text: An easy hike through the valley to the yurt camp across open pastures with beautiful mountain views and an introduction to the nomadic way of life. Upon arrival, settle into the yurts, relax, and enjoy a short acclimatization walk in the surrounding hills. In the evening, enjoy dinner under a star-filled sky surrounded by the peaceful silence of the mountains.

After breakfast, begin the trek to a scenic viewpoint offering the first panoramic views of the Pamir Mountains, followed by a descent into the valley for lunch by the river overlooking the glacier. After a short rest, continue the ascent to Sary-Mogol Pass, where breathtaking views of the high-altitude Besh-Köl lakes and surrounding peaks await. Descend to the yurt camp and enjoy dinner beneath a starry mountain sky.

A gradual descent from the highlands through ever-changing landscapes — from rocky mountain slopes to green valleys and juniper groves. Along the way, cross mountain rivers, pass shepherds’ yurts, and experience authentic village life with the opportunity to stop for tea. After lunch and a short comfortable break at a guesthouse in Kyzyl-Shoro, continue the ascent to Kosh-Moynok Pass before descending into the valley of the same name and arriving at the yurt camp.

steps.header: To Jiptik Yurt Camp via Sary-Bel and Kozhokelen
steps.text: Cross the Sary-Bel Pass with panoramic views of the Kichik-Alay Mountains, then continue through the striking red cliffs of the “Three Dragons Gorge” to the village of Kozhokelen for lunch and a short rest. After the break, follow the river through a lush green canyon to the yurt camp located at the foot of Jiptik Pass. In the evening, enjoy dinner in a traditional yurt surrounded by alpine pastures.

Ascend from the yurt camp to Jiptik Pass along a winding trail with a gradual gain in elevation. From the top, enjoy sweeping views of the Pamir Mountains and, in clear weather, Lenin Peak. After lunch, descend steeply into the Darbazatash Valley to reach the yurt camp, where you can relax and spend the night surrounded by the silence of the high mountains.

Transfer from Osh to the high-mountain village of Sary-Mogol with a stop for a light hike to Emerald Lake and lunch along the way. Upon arrival, enjoy dinner and relax at a guesthouse overlooking the Pamir Mountains.

Begin the day early with a trek to Lenin Peak Base Camp and an ascent to Travelers Pass, where you’ll enjoy the final panoramic views of the glaciers and the majestic Lenin Peak (7,134 m). After lunch overlooking the Pamirs, return to the yurt camp and transfer back to Osh, bringing your mountain adventure to a memorable close.

Transfer from Bishkek to Karakol with a stop at Burana Tower, where you can explore the ancient ruins of Balasagun, an on-site museum with archaeological artifacts, and balbals (stone statues). The journey continues along Lake Issyk-Kul, offering scenic views of both the mountains and the water. Upon arrival in Karakol, enjoy a short city walk, including visits to the Dungan Mosque and the Holy Trinity Orthodox Cathedral, followed by accommodation in a guesthouse and rest after the journey.

Transfer from Karakol to the trailhead through the scenic Karakol Valley, followed by a hike into Karakol Gorge with its rushing river, spruce-covered slopes, and grazing horses, leading to a lunch spot along the route. Continue the trek to a campsite at 2,550 meters, where you can relax and take a short walk in the surrounding mountain landscapes.
steps.city: Karakol → Start of the Tien Shan mountain trek

steps.header: To Ala-Köl Lake via Sirota Hut
steps.text: A challenging and rewarding day with a steep ascent over rocky trails and boulders via Sirota Hut, leading to the high-altitude Ala-Köl Lake at 3,500 meters. After the climb, you are rewarded with breathtaking views of its turquoise waters and surrounding glaciers. Upon arrival, set up camp in tents, enjoy free time to walk around the lake, have dinner, and rest surrounded by dramatic mountain scenery.

steps.header: Altyn-Arashan Road & Hot Springs via Ala-Köl Pass.
steps.text: Cross Ala-Köl Pass and descend gradually into the scenic Altyn-Arashan valley along mountain trails and alpine pastures, passing rivers and occasionally crossing shallow streams, all the way to a yurt camp at 2,450 meters. Upon arrival, settle into the yurts and enjoy a well-deserved rest in the natural hot sulfur springs, renowned for their restorative properties.

A gentle final trek along a mountain river through the valley, with views of Peak Palatka and the “Swallow’s Nest,” leads to Ak-Suu village. From there, transfer to Karakol for lunch, followed by a longer drive to the southern shore of Lake Issyk-Kul with a stop at Skazka Canyon along the way. Upon arrival, settle into the Bel-Tam yurt camp on the lakeshore, enjoy dinner, and relax by the water.

Transfer to the high-altitude Song-Köl Lake through scenic valleys and the village of Kochkor, with a lunch stop along the way. You may also encounter an eagle hunter en route. Upon arrival, experience nomadic life firsthand, taste kumys and ayran, and settle into yurts on the lakeshore surrounded by vast pastures and grazing herds. In the evening, enjoy dinner and unwind in the peaceful silence of the mountains.

Transfer from Lake Song-Köl southward via Moldo-Ashuu Pass along a winding mountain road with panoramic views of multi-colored ridges, including a lunch stop en route. Arrive in Kazarman for a short walk around the town. In the evening, enjoy dinner and rest at a guesthouse.

Early departure toward Lenin Peak Base Camp and ascent to Travelers Pass, offering final panoramic views of the glaciers and the majestic Lenin Peak (7,134 m). After lunch overlooking the Pamirs, return to the yurt camp and transfer back to Osh, concluding your mountain journey.

Transfer from the city of Osh to the mountain village of Koyokelen (2,200 m), enjoying scenic views along the way. Upon arrival, take a short walk in the gorge above the village, experience the peaceful atmosphere of rural life, and settle into a family-run guesthouse. In the evening, enjoy a homemade dinner and rest.

steps.header: Koyokelen – Kosh-Moynok Valley via Sary-Bel Pass
steps.text: Start of the trek from Koyokelen with a river crossing via bridge and a long ascent to Sary-Bel Pass through a gorge with the striking red cliffs of the “Three Dragons.” From the pass, enjoy panoramic views of the Kichik-Alay range and the snow-capped peaks of the Pamirs. Continue the descent along a trail through juniper forest into the Kosh-Moynok Valley. Upon arrival, settle into a yurt camp at 2,800 meters, relax, and enjoy dinner.

steps.header: Trek to Beshkol Camp via Kyzyl-Shoro
steps.text: A long and physically demanding day, ascending through alpine pastures to Kosh-Moynok Pass, then descending to the village of Kyzyl-Shoro for lunch and a rest stop. Continue with a sustained climb through the valley, crossing rivers and experiencing a gradual shift from green slopes to rugged high-altitude terrain, all the way to Beshkol Camp at 3,600 meters. Upon arrival, settle into yurts, enjoy dinner, and rest.

Trek to Sary-Mogol Pass, following a mountain stream before a steep ascent along a scree trail to an altitude of 4,306 meters, where glacier peaks and alpine lakes gradually come into view. Continue with an exciting descent through narrow rocky sections, stopping for lunch by a river with views of the glacier, before reaching the valley floor. Meet your driver and transfer to Sary-Mogol village, where you will enjoy dinner and rest at a guesthouse.

Early departure to Tulpar-Köl Lake and a trek through Lenin Peak Base Camp, followed by a gradual ascent to Travelers Pass, where the final section of the trail becomes a steep zigzag offering panoramic views of glaciers and Lenin Peak (7,134 m). After a rest and lunch at the viewpoint, return along the same route to the yurt camp for dinner and an overnight stay.

After breakfast, transfer from the yurt camp back to the city of Osh, marking the end of the route, with a final drive through the scenic valleys and mountain landscapes of the Pamir-Alay. Upon arrival in Osh, the tour concludes.

Transfer from Osh to the high-mountain village of Sary-Mogol, with panoramic views of the Pamir Mountains and scenic stops along the way. Upon arrival, check in to a guesthouse and rest before the start of the trek. In the evening, enjoy the atmosphere of the mountain village and prepare for the upcoming trekking adventure.

Transfer to Tulpar-Köl Lake followed by an acclimatization hike to the pass, offering panoramic views of glaciers and Lenin Peak. The route crosses open high-altitude landscapes with a gradual gain in elevation. After the descent, return to Sary-Mogol for rest and recovery before the next stages of the trek.

Cross one of the most impressive passes of the route, offering views of glaciers and the high-altitude Besh-Köl lakes. The trail passes through rocky sections and open panoramic viewpoints. After the pass, descend into the valley and settle into a yurt camp.

A descent through diverse landscapes — from rugged high-altitude terrain to green valleys and juniper-covered pastures. Along the way, experience nomadic life and stop in the village of Kyzyl-Shoro. After lunch, ascend to the pass and continue into the Kosh-Moynok Valley, where you will reach the camp.

Cross Sary-Bel Pass with panoramic views of the Kichik-Alay Mountains and the striking red cliffs of the “Three Dragons Gorge.” Descend to Kozhokelen village for rest and lunch. Afterwards, transfer back to Osh, marking the end of the route and time to relax after the trek.

Transfer via Taldyk Pass with the first panoramic views of the Pamir-Alay Mountains and, in good weather, Lenin Peak. After lunch, enjoy an easy trek through valleys and nomadic pastures to Zhanyryk Yurt Camp. In the evening, have dinner and relax in a traditional yurt surrounded by the complete silence of the mountains.

Trek to panoramic viewpoints overlooking the Pamirs and continue toward the high-altitude pass through rocky mountain terrain. At the summit, enjoy breathtaking views of the Besh-Köl lakes and glacier-covered peaks. After the descent, spend the night at camp surrounded by dramatic alpine landscapes.

A gradual descent through ever-changing landscapes — from rocky slopes to green pastures and juniper groves. Along the way, pass through villages, alpine meadows, and experience the atmosphere of nomadic life. After lunch in Kyzyl-Shoro, continue across the pass into the Kosh-Moynok Valley.

Ascend to Sary-Bel Pass with panoramic views of the Kichik-Alay Mountains, then continue through the striking red cliffs of the “Three Dragons Gorge.” After lunch in Kozhokelen, enjoy an easy walk along the river through a lush green canyon to the camp at the foot of Jiptik Pass.

A gradual ascent to one of the most impressive passes of the route, offering panoramic views of the Pamirs and Lenin Peak. After crossing the pass, descend steeply into the Darbazatash Valley. In the evening, enjoy dinner and an overnight stay in a yurt camp surrounded by dramatic high-altitude landscapes.

A peaceful descent toward Sary-Mogol with wide-open views of the Alay Valley and the snow-capped peaks of the Pamirs. Enjoy lunch and a short rest at a guesthouse before returning to Osh. The route concludes with time to relax and reflect after the trekking adventure.

The journey begins with a transfer from Osh toward Gulcha and далее to the starting point of the horseback route. The trail follows the Kara-Bulak River through alpine pastures and shepherds’ yurts. It then climbs onto a mountain ridge with panoramic views of the Alay Mountains. At the end of the day, descend to Tepshi Camp for an overnight stay in a traditional yurt.

The day begins with an ascent to Eiri-Bel Pass, offering wide panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. After crossing the pass, the route descends into the Cholo-Kayyng Gorge. The trail follows the river and leads to the summer camp of Sary-Oy. Here, participants can experience the lifestyle of Kyrgyz nomads and spend the night in traditional yurts.

The morning begins with an introduction to local traditions, including milking livestock and preparing dairy products. The route then follows the river through a gorge with steep slopes. After lunch, the trail continues through forested terrain toward the foot of Ak-Tor Pass. The night is spent in a yurt camp beneath the pass.

Participants ascend Ak-Tor Pass, reaching an altitude of around 3,500 meters. From the summit, breathtaking views of the Alay mountain ranges unfold in every direction. After crossing the pass, the route descends into the Murdash Valley along mountain streams. The day ends at Uch-Chat Camp, where there is an opportunity to experience the daily life of local shepherds.

The final day begins with a farewell to the host family and the local team. The route follows a scenic gorge toward the main road, where the transfer back to Osh begins. The tour concludes with arrival in the city around lunchtime.

The journey begins with a transfer from Osh toward Gulcha along the Pamir Highway. The horseback route then starts along the Kara-Bulak River, crossing alpine pastures and nomadic camps. Along the way, participants ascend a dirt road before reaching a mountain trail with panoramic views. The night is spent at Tepshi Yurt Camp at an altitude of around 2,710 meters.

After breakfast, the route climbs steadily toward Eiri-Bel Pass. The ascent is quite steep, but the summit rewards travelers with sweeping views of the Kümbel Mountains and the valleys of Alay. The trail then descends into the Cholo-Kayyn Gorge, with lunch by the river. The day ends at Sary-Oy Yurt Camp, where participants can experience the lifestyle of Kyrgyz nomads.

In the morning, the group ascends toward Kümbel Pass at an altitude of around 3,150 meters. From the top, wide panoramas of the Alay Valley unfold, along with glimpses of shepherd life in the high pastures. After lunch, the route descends toward Chyyyrchyk Pass. There, transportation meets the group for the return journey to the city of Osh

The journey begins with a departure from Bishkek toward At-Bashy through scenic valleys and mountain passes. A stop is made at Burana Tower, a historic 12th-century minaret. The road follows part of the modern Silk Road, offering views of Kyrgyz rural life along the way. Upon arrival, check-in at a guesthouse and rest.

After a short transfer, the route continues over Bosogo Pass with winding roads and panoramic views. The journey then crosses the vast Ak-Say Valley, home to nomadic yurts and grazing herds. Upon arrival at camp, enjoy lunch and rest, with an optional afternoon walk to nearby hills overlooking the valley.

After a briefing, the horseback trek begins, crossing rivers and alpine meadows. The ascent to Sazduu Pass reveals sweeping views of snow-capped peaks and high mountain valleys. Along the way, you may spot Marco Polo sheep and mountain goats. The descent leads into a green valley, where camp is set up by the river.

steps.header: Across Kar Pass to the high mountain peaks
steps.text: The route continues over Kar Pass with views of remote mountain ranges. The trail then winds through narrow valleys and crosses a river, with opportunities to observe yaks and other wildlife along the way. The night is spent at a high-altitude yurt camp in the mountains.

In the morning, the journey leads to the hidden Kel-Suu Lake, nestled among dramatic cliffs. Its turquoise waters and sheer rock walls create one of the most striking landscapes of the entire route. After time for a walk around the lake, the group returns to camp for lunch. In the afternoon, transfer to Kochkor and accommodation in a guesthouse.

After breakfast, begin the return journey to Bishkek. The road passes through scenic mountain landscapes with photo stops along the way. Upon arrival, participants can relax or explore the city. This marks the end of the journey.

The journey begins with a drive from Bishkek toward Kochkor, including stops at the Burana Complex and the scenic Kok-Moynok Canyons. After arriving in Kochkor, the group continues to Kyzart Pass, where the horseback trek begins. Here, participants meet the guides and horses. The route crosses alpine pastures and Cha’ar-Archa Pass before reaching the Kilemche Valley, where the night is spent in a traditional yurt.

After breakfast, the ascent begins toward Jalgyz Karagay Pass, leading into the high-altitude basin of Song-Köl Lake. Along the way, panoramic views of valleys and mountain ridges unfold. The route then descends toward the lakeshore, where a yurt camp awaits. The night is spent in a traditional yurt hosted by nomadic families.

The route continues along the shores of Song-Köl Lake across open pastures. The landscapes are filled with grazing herds and the daily life of local nomadic shepherds. The ride proceeds at a relaxed pace with stops for lunch along the way. In the evening, arrive at a yurt camp on the southwestern shore of the lake.

steps.header: Suk Kolot → Oyurma Pass → Uzun-Bulak Valley
steps.text: After saying farewell to the camp, the route ascends toward Oyurma Pass. From the summit, wide panoramic views open over Song-Köl Lake and the surrounding mountains. The trail then descends into greener valleys filled with streams and alpine pastures. Overnight stay is arranged at a tented camp in the mountain valley.
steps.city: Suk Kolot → Oyurma Pass → Uzun-Bulak Valley

steps.text: The final day includes a descent through valleys and a ride toward the transport meeting point. Along the way, the route passes through forested sections and mountain gorges. After lunch, the group meets the vehicle and transfers back to Kochkor. Arrival in the evening marks the end of the horseback adventure.

steps.header: Transfer from Osh to Kozhokelen Village
steps.text: The journey begins with a transfer from the city of Osh to the mountain village of Kozhokelen. Along the way, enjoy views of the Pamir-Alay Mountains and dramatic red-rock canyons. After arrival, take a light walk through the gorge and become familiar with the surroundings. Overnight stay in a family-run guesthouse with a homemade dinner.

steps.header: Trek from Kozhokelen → Sary-Bel Pass → Kosh-Moynok Valley
steps.text: The full trekking adventure begins with a gradual ascent along mountain trails through the “Three Dragons Valley.” The route passes scenic ridges and alpine meadows with panoramic views of the Pamirs. By evening, the group descends into the Kosh-Moynok Valley. Overnight stay in a yurt camp surrounded by mountains.
steps.city: Trek from Kozhokelen → Sary-Bel Pass → Kosh-Moynok Valley

steps.header: Kosh-Moynok Valley → Camp at the Foot of the Passes
steps.text: The route becomes increasingly high-altitude as vegetation fades into rocky alpine landscapes. A long trekking day leads to the next camp at around 3,600 meters above sea level. Here, travelers spend the night in yurts under more rugged mountain conditions. This stage also helps with acclimatization before reaching higher elevations.
steps.city: Kosh-Moynok Valley → Camp at the Foot of the Passes

steps.text: One of the most beautiful and challenging days of the route. The ascent to the pass reveals panoramic views of glaciers and the snow-covered summit of Lenin Peak. After crossing the pass, a long descent follows along rocky mountain slopes. By evening, the group reaches Zhanyryk Camp. Overnight stay in yurts at an altitude of around 3,300 meters.

steps.header: Approach to “Onion Meadow” Camp and the Glacier Zone
steps.text: The trail gradually enters the high-altitude zone with impressive views of the glaciers of Lenin Peak. Along the way, panoramic landscapes of ледниковые valleys and moraines unfold before the group. This stage serves as the transition toward Base Camp. Overnight stay takes place closer to the glaciers in either a tented or yurt camp.

steps.header: Trek to Lenin Peak Base Camp
steps.text: The final ascent leads to Base Camp — one of the highlights of the entire route. Here, direct views of the massive glaciers and Lenin Peak itself dominate the landscape. Travelers spend time in a true high-mountain environment and rest after the climb. This is the central point of the trek.

steps.header: Acclimatization Hikes: Tulpar-Köl Lakes or Yukhin Peak
steps.text: This day is dedicated to acclimatization walks without heavy backpacks. Participants may hike toward Travelers Pass or attempt an ascent of Yukhin Peak (around 5,130 m). From the higher viewpoints, breathtaking panoramas of the glacier and Lenin Peak unfold. Return to Base Camp for an overnight stay.

steps.header: Return to the Valley and Transfer to Osh
steps.text: Descend from the high mountains back into the warmer valley landscapes. The route passes once again through familiar gorges and alpine pastures. After completing the trek, a transfer back to the city of Osh is arranged. The tour officially concludes.

The journey begins with a scenic drive from the city of Osh along the Pamir Highway toward Chyyyrchyk Pass. From there, the trekking route starts with an ascent to Kum-Bel Pass (3,154 m), offering the first breathtaking views of the Alay Mountains. Along the way, you may observe the daily life of local shepherds and their traditional way of living. After descending through forested slopes, you arrive at Sary-Oy Yurt Camp, where a warm welcome and dinner in a traditional yurt await.

steps.header: Sary-Oy → Mountain Gorge → Foot of Ak-Tor Pass
steps.text: The morning begins with an immersion into nomadic life — the camp comes alive with milking cows and preparing traditional dairy products. The route follows a rushing mountain river through green meadows and juniper groves, creating a feeling of complete remoteness from civilization. Along the way, enjoy lunch at a shepherds’ camp overlooking rugged rocky peaks. By evening, you reach the foot of Ak-Tor Pass and spend the night in a yurt camp at an altitude of around 3,000 meters.
steps.city: Sary-Oy → Mountain Gorge → Foot of Ak-Tor Pass

steps.header: Ak-Tor Pass → Murdash Valley → Return to Osh
steps.text: The final day includes an ascent to Ak-Tor Pass (around 3,500 m), where some of the most spectacular panoramas of the journey unfold — alpine pastures and sharp mountain ridges stretching into the distance. After a short rest at the summit, the trail descends into the scenic Murdash Valley with its dramatic rock walls. The path follows a mountain stream toward the road, where transportation awaits for the return to Osh. This marks the end of a rewarding journey that combines nature, altitude, and the rich culture of the region.
steps.city: Ak-Tor Pass → Murdash Valley → Return to Osh

steps.text: The journey begins with a transfer from the city of Osh to the mountain village of Uzgurush, located at the foot of the range. Along the way, enjoy views of the Fergana Valley and rural landscapes. Upon arrival, participants meet the trekking team and prepare for the start of the adventure. Overnight stay in a guesthouse.

This day marks the beginning of the trekking route through the scenic Ak-Suu Valley. The trail follows the river through green meadows and rocky slopes. The gradual ascent allows participants to adapt to both the altitude and the physical effort. Overnight stay in a tented camp.

The route leads toward Ak-Tubek Pass, one of the key highlights of the trek. The ascent is demanding, but the summit rewards travelers with panoramic views of towering peaks. After crossing the pass, the trail descends into the Orto-Chashma Valley. Camp is set up in a picturesque mountain setting.

Participants continue through high-altitude pastures and ascend toward Kosh-Moynok Pass. The landscape becomes harsher, with glacial terrain appearing along the route. From the pass, wide views of surrounding mountain ranges unfold in every direction. Camp is established after the descent.

The trail leads into the famous Kara-Suu Valley, known for its dramatic granite walls and sharp mountain peaks. The route crosses alpine meadows and follows mountain rivers. This is considered one of the most scenic sections of the trek. Camp is set at the foot of the mountains.

This day is dedicated to exploring the surroundings of Kara-Suu Valley. Optional hikes to glaciers and panoramic viewpoints are available. Participants can rest and fully enjoy the landscapes often referred to as the “Asian Patagonia.” Overnight stay in the same camp.

The route includes an ascent to Kara-Suu Pass, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks. After crossing the pass, the trail descends into the Egiz-Jar Valley. The landscapes gradually soften, revealing greener and more open scenery. Camp is set up in the valley.

The trek continues through wide valleys and alpine pastures toward the Ak-Tatyr area. Participants pass through a variety of natural zones, each with its own character. This section is relatively easy and allows more time to enjoy the surrounding nature. Overnight stay in a tented camp or guesthouse.

On this day, the route returns toward the village of Uzgurush. The trail passes through familiar landscapes that now feel different after days spent in the mountains. This marks the end of the trekking portion of the adventure. Overnight stay in a guesthouse.

After breakfast, a transfer back to the city of Osh is arranged. Along the way, participants can once again enjoy the scenery of the region. Upon arrival, there is time for accommodation and rest. This concludes the active part of the journey.

The final day is dedicated to participants’ departure. Depending on flight schedules, a transfer to the airport can be arranged. The tour program officially comes to an end, leaving travelers with unforgettable memories of Kyrgyzstan.

The journey begins with a transfer from the city of Karakol to Karakol Gorge. From here, participants take a radial hike toward the foot of Karakol Peak, passing through conifer forests and alpine meadows. The trail gradually gains elevation, revealing views of the peaks of the Teskey Ala-Too Range. In the evening, return to camp and overnight stay in tents.

steps.header: Ascent to Ala-Köl Lake via Sirota Hut
steps.text: The day begins with a trek deeper into the mountains toward Ala-Köl Lake. The route crosses rocky terrain and includes a steep climb in elevation. After several hours of ascent, participants reach the lake at around 3,500 meters above sea level. Camp is set up here, with time to rest by the lakeshore.
steps.city: Ascent to Ala-Köl Lake via Sirota Hut
steps.alt: Ascent to Ala-Köl Lake via Sirota Hut

steps.text: In the morning, the climb begins toward Ala-Köl Pass, located at nearly 3,900 meters. From the summit, panoramic views open over glaciers and the mountain ridges of the Teskey Ala-Too. A long descent then leads into the Altyn-Arashan Valley through alpine meadows and forests. In the evening, arrival in the valley and relaxation in the natural hot springs.

After time to rest in Altyn-Arashan Valley, the route descends along a scenic trail following the river. The trek passes through forested areas and mountain gorges with a gradual loss of elevation. Along the way, enjoy the final views of the Teskey Ala-Too peaks. The trek concludes with the return to Karakol.

The journey begins with a drive from Bishkek toward the village of Kochkor. Along the way, visit the ancient Burana Tower — a historical monument of the Great Silk Road. The route also includes a walk through the Kok-Moynok Canyons with their striking red rock formations. In the evening, arrival in Kochkor, dinner, and overnight stay in a guesthouse.

After breakfast, the group heads toward Kyzart Pass, where the horseback part of the expedition begins. The route crosses the wide pastures of Kyzyl-Kiya and Cha’ar-Archa Pass. Along the way, enjoy views of Baba-Ata Mountain and surrounding valleys. Overnight stay in a yurt camp in Kilemche.

In the morning, the ascent begins toward Jalgyz-Karagay Pass with panoramic mountain views. Gradually, Song-Köl Lake appears, surrounded by high mountain ranges. After descending, the trail follows the lakeshore among shepherd camps and grazing herds. The night is spent in a yurt hosted by a local family.

The route continues along the shores of Song-Köl Lake. The trail passes through open pastures filled with grazing livestock and vast open landscapes. Throughout the day, participants can fully enjoy the peace and natural beauty of the region. Overnight stay in a yurt camp on the southwestern shore of the lake.

After breakfast, a long transfer begins toward Kel-Suu Lake. Along the way, the route crosses mountain passes, valleys, and the town of Naryn. After a lunch stop, the journey continues into the remote Ak-Say Valley. In the evening, arrival and overnight stay in a guesthouse.

A new stage of the horseback expedition begins toward Kel-Suu Lake. The trail crosses rivers and alpine meadows before ascending to Sazduu Pass. From the summit, panoramic views open over snow-covered mountains and untouched wilderness. Overnight stay in a tented camp by the river.

The route continues across Kar Pass with sweeping views of remote mountain ranges. The trail follows narrow mountain paths and passes through wild valleys. Along the way, participants cross rivers and may spot yaks and mountain goats. Overnight stay is arranged in a yurt camp.

On this day, participants reach Kel-Suu Lake, hidden among dramatic cliffs. Its turquoise waters and steep rock walls create a truly breathtaking landscape. After spending time by the lake, the group returns and transfers to Naryn. In the evening, accommodation is provided in a guesthouse.

After breakfast, the return journey to Bishkek begins. The road passes through scenic mountain and valley landscapes. Upon arrival, participants may relax or explore the city. This marks the end of the journey.

The journey begins with a horseback ride through the narrow Kara-Suu Gorge, covered in dense spruce forests. The trail follows the river, gradually opening views of the Muztor peaks. Along the way, you may encounter summer settlements of locals engaged in beekeeping and livestock herding. Overnight stay near Lake Kara-Suu at around 1,800 meters.

The route crosses pastures where you can observe nomadic life and experience local hospitality. The ascent leads to Makmal Pass (2,651 m), offering panoramic views of mountain peaks. The descent passes through tall grasslands, sometimes reaching human height. Overnight stay on the northern shore of Lake Sary-Chelek.

The day begins with a climb to Ashuu Pass, where in some sections you may need to walk alongside your horse. From the summit, breathtaking views open over valleys, mountains, and alpine lakes of the reserve. The descent leads through raspberry bushes and walnut forests. Camp is set up near Lake Iri-Köl.

The final day passes through dense walnut forests and green valleys. Along the way, you will observe local rural life: haymaking, livestock grazing, and beekeeping. The route gradually leads to the village of Kyzyl-Köl, where participants are welcomed with warm hospitality and a homemade meal in a guesthouse.

The journey begins with a transfer from Bishkek to the scenic Jeti-Oguz Valley. Along the way, enjoy views of the southern shore of Issyk-Kul and the famous red rock formations known as the “Seven Bulls.” The route then continues into the alpine Kok-Jaiyk Gorge. Overnight stay in a yurt camp.

steps.header: Kok-Jaiyk → Foot of Oguz-Bashi Peak → Telety Camp
steps.text: The route leads toward the foot of the majestic Oguz-Bashi Peak. The trail passes through forests, alpine meadows, and pastures where yaks and horses graze freely. After a picnic break, the ascent toward Telety Pass begins. By evening, a tented camp is set up in the mountain zone.
steps.city: Kok-Jaiyk → Foot of Oguz-Bashi Peak → Telety Camp
steps.alt: Kok-Jaiyk → Foot of Oguz-Bashi Peak → Telety Camp

steps.text: In the morning, the trek crosses Telety Pass at around 3,800 meters. From the summit, panoramic views open over the ridges of the Tien Shan Mountains. The route then descends into Karakol Gorge along a mountain river. Overnight stay in a tented camp surrounded by spruce forests.

This day is dedicated to a radial hike toward the foot of Karakol Peak. The trail passes through forests and alpine meadows filled with wildflowers. Along the way, views open over glaciers and dramatic rock formations. Return to camp in the evening and relax by the campfire.

The ascent begins toward one of the most beautiful lakes in Kyrgyzstan — Ala-Köl. The trail follows rocky paths along a mountain river and through forested sections. After a demanding climb, the turquoise lake appears at an altitude of around 3,500 meters. Overnight stay in a tented camp by the lake.

An early morning ascent leads to Ala-Köl Pass at approximately 3,900 meters. From the summit, panoramic views unfold across the ridges of the Tien Shan Mountains. The route then descends into the Altyn-Arashan Valley. In the evening, relax in the natural hot springs and spend the night in yurts.
In the morning, descend from Altyn-Arashan Valley to Karakol, marking the end of the trekking portion of the route. Afterwards, transfer back to Bishkek. This concludes the Tien Shan adventure.

The journey begins with a transfer from the city of Osh toward the Aflatun Valley. Along the way, enjoy views of mountain ranges and rural landscapes of southern Kyrgyzstan. Upon arrival, the first tented camp is set up by the river. In the evening, there is time to relax and become acquainted with the natural beauty of the region before the trek begins.

The route follows the South Aflatun River through a scenic mountain gorge. The trail gradually gains elevation, passing through alpine meadows and forests of Tien Shan spruce. Along the way, you may encounter nomads and grazing herds. Overnight stay in a tented camp by the river.

This day begins with an ascent to Kuldambes Pass, offering panoramic views of the surrounding mountain ridges. After crossing the pass, the route continues toward Lake Sary-Chelek. The descent leads through green slopes and alpine pastures. Camp is set up on the lakeshore.

The trail follows the lakeshore before climbing toward Makmal Pass. From the summit, wide views open over the mountain peaks and valleys of the region. After crossing the pass, the route descends toward the Kyzyl-Suu Valley. Overnight stay in a tented camp surrounded by mountain scenery.

The route descends through the Kara-Suu River Valley, passing scenic mountain landscapes. Along the way, you may encounter alpine pastures and nomadic camps. The trail then leads to the alpine Lake Karakamysh. Camp is set up by the water with panoramic mountain views.

The ascent leads to Kotormo Pass, offering wide panoramas over the Sary-Chelek region. After crossing the summit, the trail descends toward Lake Iri-Köl. The landscapes become greener and more open. Overnight stay in a tented camp by the lakeshore.

The route follows forest trails lined with walnut and fruit trees. Participants return to the main Sary-Chelek Lake for the final panoramic views of the journey. After a rest by the lake, a transfer back to Osh is organized. In the evening, the trekking adventure concludes with arrival in the city.

The journey begins with a departure from Bishkek toward Lake Issyk-Kul. Along the way, visit the historic Burana Tower, linked to the Silk Road era. The route continues through the Fairytale Canyon with its striking rock formations. The day ends upon arrival at the “Bel-Tam” yurt camp, dinner, and an overnight stay in a traditional yurt by the lake.

This day is dedicated to the Jeti-Oguz Valley, famous for its red rock formations “Seven Bulls” and “Broken Heart.” En route, stop at Barskoon Waterfall. The journey continues with a hike across alpine meadows toward a viewpoint overlooking the glacial peak Oguz-Bashi. In the evening, return to the yurt camp for rest.

In the morning, there is an optional walk to a mountain waterfall in the Jeti-Oguz area. Afterwards, transfer to the town of Kochkor through scenic mountain and rural landscapes. Upon arrival, check-in at a guesthouse. In the afternoon, explore the village and optionally take part in a traditional felt carpet (shyrdak)

Transfer to the high-altitude Song-Köl Lake via scenic mountain passes and summer pastures. Upon arrival, settle into a yurt camp and enjoy lunch. The lake is surrounded by nomadic settlements and alpine meadows. In the afternoon, optional walks or horseback rides along the lakeshore are available.

The day begins with a drive across the impressive Moldo-Ashuu mountain pass. Along the way, panoramic views open over high-altitude valleys and scattered yurt settlements. The journey continues along winding mountain roads with scenic stops. In the evening, arrival in the village of Kazarman and rest in a guesthouse.

A transfer via Kaldama Pass leads to the Arslanbob region, home to the world’s largest walnut forest. Upon arrival, enjoy walks to waterfalls and along mountain trails. Optional hikes offer panoramic views over the valley. In the evening, check-in at a guesthouse and dinner.

In the morning, hike to the 80-meter Arslanbob waterfall and enjoy panoramic views over the village. After lunch, transfer to Osh. On the way, visit the Uzgen Minaret and Mausoleum, historic monuments from the Karakhanid era. In the evening, arrival in Osh and end of the journey.

Transfer from Osh to Arslanbob village along scenic mountain roads. Upon arrival, check-in at a guesthouse and introduction to the area. Arslanbob is famous for having the largest walnut forest in Central Asia. In the evening, a walk through the village and relaxation.

Transfer over Kaldama Pass with stops at panoramic viewpoints. The road passes through high mountain landscapes and ridgelines. Arrival in Kazarman and accommodation in a guesthouse. Evening walk along the Naryn River.

Journey across Moldo-Ashuu Pass with panoramic mountain views. Along the way, encounter nomadic yurts and summer pastures. Arrival at the high-altitude Song-Köl Lake. Overnight stay in a yurt camp by the lake.

Morning walks or optional horseback rides along the shores of Song-Köl. After lunch, transfer via Kalmak-Ashuu Pass. Stop en route in Kochkor town. Arrival at the southern shore of Issyk-Kul Lake and accommodation in a camp.

Travel along the southern shore of Issyk-Kul with stops in scenic canyons. Visit the “Fairytale” Canyon and Barskoon Waterfall. Continue toward the Jeti-Oguz Valley. Overnight stay in a yurt camp surrounded by mountains.
A day hike to a panoramic viewpoint overlooking Oguz-Bashi Peak. Walk through alpine meadows and mountain gorges. After lunch, transfer to Karakol city. Check-in at a hotel and rest.

A long drive back to Bishkek along the northern shore of Issyk-Kul. Stops along the way include the petroglyphs of Cholpon-Ata and the Burana Tower. Arrival in Bishkek in the evening, marking the end of the route.

steps.header: Bishkek → Burana Tower → Ak-Sai Canyons → Issyk-Kul
steps.text: The journey begins with a departure from Bishkek to the Burana Tower, a historical monument from the Silk Road era. The route then continues to the Ak-Sai Canyons for a short walk with scenic views over Lake Issyk-Kul. Afterwards, the group proceeds to a yurt camp on the lakeshore. In the evening, enjoy a walk by the water or relax in the yurts.
steps.city: Bishkek → Burana Tower → Ak-Sai Canyons → Issyk-Kul
steps.alt: Bishkek → Burana Tower → Ak-Sai Canyons → Issyk-Kul

steps.header: Issyk-Kul → Bokonbaev → Fairy Tale Canyon → Barskoon Gorge → Svetlaya Polyana
steps.text: The day starts with an eagle hunting demonstration and an introduction to nomadic traditions. The route then follows the southern shore of Issyk-Kul to Fairy Tale Canyon with its striking red rock formations. After a walk through the canyon, the journey continues to Barskoon Gorge with its waterfalls. In the evening, transfer and accommodation in a guesthouse in Svetlaya Polyana.
steps.city: Issyk-Kul → Bokonbaev → Fairy Tale Canyon → Barskoon Gorge → Svetlaya Polyana
steps.alt: Issyk-Kul → Bokonbaev → Fairy Tale Canyon → Barskoon Gorge → Svetlaya Polyana

steps.header: Svetlaya Polyana → Jeti-Oguz → Kok-Zhayyk → Oguz-Bashi Peak → Svetlaya Polyana
steps.text: Participants travel to Jeti-Oguz Gorge, famous for its red rock formations. The trek continues through Kok-Zhayyk valley with alpine meadows and pastures. The route leads to a panoramic viewpoint overlooking Oguz-Bashi Peak (Boris Yeltsin Peak). After the hike, the group returns to the guesthouse.
steps.city: Svetlaya Polyana → Jeti-Oguz → Kok-Zhayyk → Oguz-Bashi Peak → Svetlaya Polyana
steps.alt: Svetlaya Polyana → Jeti-Oguz → Kok-Zhayyk → Oguz-Bashi Peak → Svetlaya Polyana

steps.text: The transfer passes through diverse mountain landscapes and high passes. A stop in Kochkor includes a visit to a traditional felt carpet workshop. The journey continues to high-altitude Song-Köl Lake. In the evening, check-in at a yurt camp and rest by the lake.

This day is dedicated to exploring the Song-Köl region. You can enjoy hiking across the vast alpine pastures and along the lakeshore. An optional horseback ride is available to experience authentic nomadic culture. In the evening, return to the yurt camp and relax.

After breakfast, a long drive begins through the Naryn region. Along the way, you will see high mountain plateaus and valleys with nomadic settlements. After a stop in Naryn, the journey continues into the Aksai Valley. In the evening, accommodation in a guesthouse near the Kel-Suu region.

This day is dedicated to a trip and trek to Kel-Suu Lake. The route passes through a wide glacial valley surrounded by dramatic cliffs and peaks. The lake can be reached either on foot or on horseback. After the visit, return journey toward Naryn.

The final day includes a return to Bishkek via mountain passes and valleys. A stop is planned in Boom Gorge for rest and lunch. The road continues through scenic canyons along the Chu River. Arrival in Bishkek marks the end of the tour.

The journey begins with departure from Bishkek and a short city orientation. The route then leads to Burana Tower, an ancient monument from the Silk Road era in the city of Balasagun. After visiting the historical complex, the group continues to Kochkor village. In the evening, arrival, dinner, and overnight stay in a guesthouse.

steps.header: Kochkor → Kyzart Pass → Chaar-Archa Pass → Kilemche
steps.text: The route starts with a transfer to Kyzart Pass and meeting the horse team. The trail continues through the high mountain pastures of Kyzyl-Kiya and across Chaar-Archa Pass. Lunch is organized along the way by a mountain river with panoramic views. In the evening, accommodation and overnight stay in the Kilemche yurt camp.
steps.city: Kochkor → Kyzart Pass → Chaar-Archa Pass → Kilemche
steps.alt: Kochkor → Kyzart Pass → Chaar-Archa Pass → Kilemche

steps.text: After breakfast, ascent through Jalgys-Karagai Pass begins with wide high-altitude panoramas. Gradually, views of the Song-Köl basin open up. The descent leads to the lake shore with a lunch stop en route. In the evening, accommodation in a yurt camp with local herders.

The day is dedicated to experiencing life at the high-altitude lake and observing nomadic traditions. Optional participation in mare milking and traditional food preparation is possible. After lunch, transfer via mountain roads to Naryn city. In the evening, hotel check-in and rest.

After breakfast, a long drive begins through scenic mountain regions. Along the way, views of the At-Bashy range and canyons unfold. After a stop in Naryn, the journey continues toward the Aksai Valley. In the evening, arrival and accommodation in a yurt camp near Kel-Suu Lake.

In the morning, trekking begins toward Kel-Suu Lake through a glacial valley. The route passes among cliffs, alpine pastures, and nomadic camps. A picnic and free time by the lake are planned upon arrival. After returning, overnight stay in the yurt camp.

A long drive leads through Naryn and mountain passes toward Issyk-Kul Lake. Stops for rest and lunch are planned along the way. By evening, the group arrives in the Bokonbaev area. Accommodation in a yurt camp on the lakeshore.

steps.header: Issyk-Kul → Fairy Tale Canyon → Barskoon → Jeti-Oguz
steps.text: The route includes a visit to Fairy Tale Canyon with its striking red rock formations. The journey then continues to the Barskoon waterfalls. Afterwards, the group heads to Jeti-Oguz Gorge for an overnight stay in a yurt camp. Evening relaxation surrounded by mountain scenery.
steps.city: Issyk-Kul → Fairy Tale Canyon → Barskoon → Jeti-Oguz
steps.alt: Issyk-Kul → Fairy Tale Canyon → Barskoon → Jeti-Oguz

steps.text: In the morning, a trek begins toward a panoramic viewpoint overlooking Oguz-Bashi Peak. The trail follows the river and passes through alpine meadows. After lunch, return to the camp and transfer to Karakol. Dinner and overnight stay at a hotel in the evening.

The day begins with a transfer to Karakol Gorge and the start of the trekking route. The trail follows the river through coniferous forests and mountain slopes. After lunch, the ascent continues toward a high-altitude campsite. In the evening, rest in a tent camp.

A challenging trek leads through rocky trails toward Ala-Köl Lake. After several hours of ascent, the turquoise glacial lake finally comes into view. Participants settle into a tent camp near the water. Free time and rest in the evening.

In the morning, ascent to Ala-Köl Pass with panoramic views of the Tien Shan mountains. A steep descent then begins into the Altyn-Arashan Valley. Along the way, the route passes through alpine meadows with a lunch break en route. In the evening, relaxation in a yurt camp and optional hot springs.

After a morning walk, the route continues down the valley along the river. The trail passes through forests and mountain streams. In Ak-Suu village, the group meets the transport vehicle. Transfer to Karakol and accommodation in a hotel.

The final day begins with the drive back toward Bishkek. Along the way, there is a stop at the petroglyph museum in Cholpon-Ata. After lunch, the journey continues along Issyk-Kul Lake. Arrival in Bishkek in the evening marks the end of the tour.

steps.header: Bishkek → Burana Tower → Kalmak-Ashuu Pass → Song-Köl
steps.text: The journey begins with a drive from Bishkek toward Song-Köl Lake. Along the way, the group visits Burana Tower — a historical monument from the Silk Road era. From Kalmak-Ashuu Pass, breathtaking views open over the high-altitude lake. After descending, accommodation in a yurt camp and a walk along the lakeshore.
steps.city: Bishkek → Burana Tower → Kalmak-Ashuu Pass → Song-Köl

steps.header: Song-Köl → Moldo-Ashuu Pass → Naryn → Tash Rabat
steps.text: The route passes through the scenic Moldo-Ashuu Pass with its dramatic mountain switchbacks. Along the road, colorful mountain ridges unfold in every direction. After a stop in Naryn, the group continues toward the ancient Tash Rabat caravanserai. In the evening, tour of the historical complex and overnight in a yurt.
steps.city: Song-Köl → Moldo-Ashuu Pass → Naryn → Tash Rabat
steps.alt: Song-Köl → Moldo-Ashuu Pass → Naryn → Tash Rabat

steps.text: This day includes a long drive along the Naryn River. Along the way, you will see alpine pastures dotted with yurts and surrounded by mountain passes. The landscapes gradually change from rugged highlands to softer green valleys. In the evening, arrival in Kazarman and accommodation in a guesthouse.

The route crosses Kaldama Pass with panoramic views of mountain ranges. The road then descends through scenic mountain slopes and diverse natural landscapes. By evening, arrival in Osh and hotel accommodation.

The journey continues toward the Pamirs via Taldyk Pass. Along the way, wide valleys with alpine pastures and grazing yaks come into view. After arriving in Sary-Mogol, the route continues toward Tulpar-Köl Lake. In the evening, accommodation in a yurt camp with stunning views of Lenin Peak.

steps.header: Tulpar-Köl → Traveller’s Pass → Border Crossing → Karakul
steps.text: In the morning, a radial hike begins toward Traveller’s Pass with panoramic views of glaciers and surrounding peaks. After returning, the group heads toward the Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border. The drive continues through Kyzylart Pass with dramatic high-altitude scenery. In the evening, arrival at Karakul Lake and accommodation in a guesthouse.
steps.city: Tulpar-Köl → Traveller’s Pass → Border Crossing → Karakul
steps.alt: Tulpar-Köl → Traveller’s Pass → Border Crossing → Karakul

steps.text: The route crosses Ak-Baital Pass, one of the highest mountain passes in the region. Along the way, breathtaking views of the Pamirs and glaciers unfold. After a stop in Murghab, the journey continues toward Alichur. In the evening, accommodation in a guesthouse and introduction to the local culture.

steps.header: Alichur → Maljuran Valley → Mahan Summit → Yurt Camp
steps.text: This day is dedicated to hiking in the scenic Maljuran Valley. The trail leads to panoramic viewpoints overlooking lakes and mountain ridges. For those interested, an optional ascent to Mahan Summit is possible. After returning, relaxation in the yurt camp and visits to nearby hot springs.
steps.city: Alichur → Maljuran Valley → Mahan Summit → Yurt Camp
steps.alt: Alichur → Maljuran Valley → Mahan Summit → Yurt Camp

steps.header: Maljuran → Khargush Pass → Panorama Ridge → Langar
steps.text: In the morning, transfer to Khargush Pass followed by the start of a mountain hike. From the summit, spectacular views open over the Afghan Wakhan Corridor and the Pamirs. After descending, the route follows the river toward the Wakhan Valley. In the evening, arrival in Langar and accommodation in a guesthouse.
steps.city: Maljuran → Khargush Pass → Panorama Ridge → Langar
steps.alt: Maljuran → Khargush Pass → Panorama Ridge → Langar

steps.header: Langar → Yamchun → Bibi Fatima → Ishkashim → Khorog
steps.text: The route includes a visit to Yamchun Fortress with sweeping panoramic views. The group then visits the famous Bibi Fatima hot springs. Along the way, historical landmarks and traditional villages are explored. In the evening, arrival in Khorog, a short walk through town, and overnight stay at a hotel.
steps.city: Langar → Yamchun → Bibi Fatima → Ishkashim → Khorog
steps.alt: Langar → Yamchun → Bibi Fatima → Ishkashim → Khorog

steps.text: The journey continues into the remote Bartang Valley. From there, a hiking route begins toward the lakes near Jizeu. The trail follows mountain rivers and passes through untouched wilderness. In the evening, accommodation in a guesthouse in this isolated and peaceful region.

In the morning, return to the vehicle and continuation of the route. The road follows rivers and valleys with constantly changing mountain scenery. The journey continues along the border with Afghanistan. By evening, arrival in Qalai-Khumb and accommodation in a guesthouse.

The final day includes a scenic drive to Dushanbe along the Panj River. Along the way, views of mountain gorges and traditional villages unfold. Stops are planned at historical landmarks and panoramic viewpoints. In the evening, arrival in Dushanbe and the end of the journey.

The journey begins with a drive from Dushanbe along the legendary Pamir Highway. Along the way, the group visits the 11th-century Hulbuk Palace, an important historical landmark of the region. The road then continues through Shurobod Pass, offering scenic views of mountain valleys and dramatic landscapes. In the evening, arrival in Qalai-Khumb and accommodation in a hotel by the Panj River.

The route leads into the remote and wild Bartang Valley. From there, a hiking trail begins toward the isolated village of Jizeu. The path passes through untouched mountain landscapes, rivers, and narrow valleys far from civilization. In the evening, accommodation in a guesthouse hosted by local families.

In the morning, the group hikes back to the main road. The journey then continues by vehicle toward the town of Khorog. Along the way, several stops are planned for photographs of the dramatic mountain scenery. In the evening, hotel accommodation and free time to explore the town.

The route follows the Panj River through the famous Wakhan Corridor. Along the road, breathtaking views open toward Afghan villages and rugged mountain ranges. The group visits the ancient Yamchun Fortress and the Bibi Fatima hot springs. In the evening, arrival in Langar and accommodation in a guesthouse.

In the morning, transfer to Khargush Pass and the beginning of a scenic hiking route. The ascent leads to panoramic ridges overlooking the Pamirs and the mountains of Afghanistan. After descending, the journey continues toward Bulunkul Lake. In the evening, accommodation in the Maljuran yurt camp.

The day begins with a hike through the mountains of the Pamirs. The trail leads to panoramic viewpoints and, for those interested, an optional ascent to Mahan Summit. From the top, breathtaking views open over alpine lakes and remote valleys of the region. After descending, the group transfers to the village of Alichur and settles into a guesthouse.

The route passes through the high-altitude town of Murghab, one of the most remote settlements in the Pamirs. The journey then continues over Ak-Baital Pass — one of the highest mountain passes in the region. After descending, spectacular views of Karakul Lake appear among the rugged landscapes. In the evening, accommodation in a guesthouse near the lake.

An early departure leads toward the border between Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan. After crossing, the route continues through dramatic mountain scenery toward the village of Sary-Mogol. From there, a short drive brings the group to Tulpar-Köl Lake at the foot of Lenin Peak. In the evening, accommodation in a traditional yurt camp.

In the morning, a hike begins toward Traveller’s Pass with panoramic views of glaciers and surrounding peaks. After returning, the group departs for the city of Osh. The road passes through mountain valleys and scenic highland passes. In the evening, hotel accommodation and rest.

The day begins with a short city tour of Osh and its main landmarks. The route then continues through Kaldama Pass with sweeping panoramic mountain views. Landscapes gradually change from steep mountain slopes to broad valleys. In the evening, arrival in Kazarman and accommodation in a guesthouse.

The journey continues along the Naryn River through scenic mountain passes and wide valleys. Along the road, you may see alpine pastures dotted with yurts of nomadic families. After a stop in Naryn, the route heads toward the ancient caravanserai of Tash Rabat. In the evening, accommodation in a yurt camp and exploration of the historic complex.

The route leads toward the high-altitude lake of Song-Köl. Along the way, vast valleys and endless pastures unfold across the mountains. From the mountain pass, panoramic views open over the lake and surrounding highlands. In the evening, accommodation in a yurt camp and a peaceful walk along the lakeshore.

The final day includes departure toward Bishkek. Along the way, a stop is made in Kochkor, where travelers can discover local handicrafts and traditional felt-making culture. The road continues through mountain passes and scenic valleys. In the evening, arrival in Bishkek and the end of the journey.

The journey begins with a departure from Dushanbe along the Pamir Highway. On the way, the group visits the 11th-century Hulbuk Palace. The road then continues through Shurobod Pass with scenic mountain valleys. In the evening, arrival in Qalai-Khumb and accommodation in a hotel by the Panj River.

The route leads into the remote Bartang Valley. From there, a hiking trail begins toward the isolated village of Jizeu. The path passes through wild and sparsely populated mountain landscapes. In the evening, accommodation in a guesthouse with local families.

In the morning, the group hikes back to the main road. The journey then continues by vehicle to the town of Khorog. Along the way, stops are made for photographing the mountain landscapes. In the evening, hotel accommodation and free time.

The route follows the Panj River through the Wakhan Corridor. Along the way, views open over Afghan mountains and villages. The group visits Yamchun Fortress and the Bibi Fatima hot springs. In the evening, arrival in Langar and accommodation in a guesthouse.

In the morning, transfer to Khargush Pass and the start of a hiking route. The ascent leads to a panoramic ridge with views over the Pamirs and Afghan mountains. After descending, the journey continues toward Bulunkul Lake. In the evening, accommodation in the Maljuran yurt camp.

The day begins with a hike in the Pamir Mountains. The trail leads to panoramic viewpoints and, if desired, to the summit of Mahan Peak. From the top, views open over lakes and valleys of the region. After descending, transfer to the village of Alichur and accommodation in a guesthouse.

The route passes through the high-altitude town of Murghab. The journey then continues over Ak-Baital Pass — one of the highest passes in the region. After descending, views open over Karakul Lake. In the evening, accommodation in a guesthouse near the lake.

An early departure leads to the border between Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan. After crossing, the route continues through mountain landscapes to the village of Sary-Mogol. From there, a short drive leads to Tulpar-Köl Lake at the foot of Lenin Peak. In the evening, accommodation in a yurt camp.

In the morning, a hike begins toward Traveller’s Pass with glacier views. After returning, the group continues to the city of Osh. The road passes through mountain valleys and high passes. In the evening, hotel accommodation.

The journey begins with a drive along the Pamir Highway through Shurobod Pass, including a visit to the 11th-century Hulbuk Palace and the first views of the Panj River and Afghanistan. Overnight in a guesthouse in Kalai-Khumb.
The road runs through scenic mountain gorges and along the Panj River with stops for photography. Arrival in Khorog, with a visit to one of the highest-altitude botanical gardens in the world.
The route passes through the Wakhan Corridor, including a visit to the 12th-century Yamchun Fortress, the Bibi Fatima hot springs, and panoramic views of Afghan mountains along the Panj River.

After visiting ancient petroglyphs, the journey continues with a hike to the Panoramic Ridge (4800 m), offering views of the Wakhan Range and the high-altitude lakes Bulunkul and Yashilkul, followed by transfer to Alichur.
A journey through the Eastern Pamirs includes experiencing the nomadic lifestyle of Kyrgyz families, the opportunity to ride yaks, crossing Ak-Baital Pass (4,655 m), and arrival at Karakul Lake.

steps.header: Karakul Lake → Kyzyl-Art Pass → Sary-Mogol → Tulpar-Köl Lake
steps.text: After crossing the Tajik–Kyrgyz border, the route continues through the Alay Valley toward the scenic Tulpar-Köl Lake at the foot of Lenin Peak, where accommodation is in a yurt camp.
steps.city: Karakul Lake → Kyzyl-Art Pass → Sary-Mogol → Tulpar-Köl Lake
steps.alt: Karakul Lake → Kyzyl-Art Pass → Sary-Mogol → Tulpar-Köl Lake

steps.text: A morning hike to Traveller’s Pass (4,130 m) offers views of the glaciers of Lenin Peak, followed by a drive to the ancient city of Osh, marking the end of the journey.

steps.header: Tashkent → Old City → Khast-Imam → City Center
steps.text: Arrival in Tashkent and transfer to the hotel, with luggage drop-off available before check-in. The tour begins in the Old City with the Khast-Imam complex, home to important historical and religious monuments. The program continues with visits to Chorsu Bazaar, the metro, and the city’s main squares. The day ends with hotel check-in and free time.
steps.city: Tashkent → Old City → Khast-Imam → City Center
steps.alt: Tashkent → Old City → Khast-Imam → City Center

steps.text: Morning flight to Urgench followed by transfer to Khiva. Upon arrival, the sightseeing tour of Itchan Kala, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, begins. The program includes numerous historical madrasahs, mosques, and palaces. In the evening, free time and overnight stay in Khiva.

Drive from Khiva to Bukhara through the Kyzylkum Desert, covering a long but scenic route. Along the way, characteristic Central Asian landscapes unfold. Arrival in Bukhara and hotel check-in. In the evening, free time to walk through the old city.

steps.header: Bukhara → Historic Center → Lyab-i Hauz → Old City
steps.text: The Bukhara sightseeing tour begins with visits to mausoleums and the Ark Fortress. The route continues to the Lyab-i Hauz ансамбль, madrasahs, and trading domes. After lunch, exploration of additional architectural monuments continues. In the evening, dinner with a traditional show and free time.
steps.city: Bukhara → Historic Center → Lyab-i Hauz → Old City
steps.alt: Bukhara → Historic Center → Lyab-i Hauz → Old City

steps.text: In the morning, the sightseeing program continues around Bukhara with a visit to the summer residence of the Emir and the Naqshbandi Mausoleum. After lunch, transfer to the train station and departure to Samarkand by train. Upon arrival, hotel check-in and rest. In the evening, free time in the city.

The tour begins with the Shah-i-Zinda necropolis and the Bibi-Khanym Mosque. Next, visit to Siab Bazaar and the central Registan Square. After lunch, the program continues with the Gur-e-Amir Mausoleum and the Ulugh Beg Observatory. Evening free time.
Free time in Samarkand until departure. In the afternoon, board the high-speed “Afrosiyob” train to Tashkent. Upon arrival, transfer to the hotel and check-in. Evening at leisure in the capital.
Free morning and hotel check-out. Transfer to the airport depending on flight time. End of the Uzbekistan tour. The journey comes to an end.

steps.header: Arrival in Tashkent → City Center → Khast-Imam → Chorsu Bazaar → Amir Timur Square
steps.text: Arrival in Tashkent and meeting the driver at the airport, followed by hotel check-in. The sightseeing tour begins with the Khast-Imam complex and its historical monuments. The group then visits Chorsu Bazaar, known for its vibrant Eastern atmosphere. The day ends with a walk through the city and dinner at an Uzbek restaurant.
steps.city: Arrival in Tashkent → City Center → Khast-Imam → Chorsu Bazaar → Amir Timur Square
steps.alt: Arrival in Tashkent → City Center → Khast-Imam → Chorsu Bazaar → Amir Timur Square

steps.text: After breakfast, departure from Tashkent to the Tian Shan Mountains. An 8 km hike begins toward Kyzyl-Djar Mountain with its red cliffs and panoramic views. Along the way, views open over the mountains and Chimgan village. In the evening, accommodation in a chalet and relaxation at the mountain resort.

steps.header: Chimgan → Small Chimgan → Tashkent → Night train to Khiva
steps.text: The day is dedicated to a trek to one of the most beautiful lakes in the Fann Mountains — Kulikalon. The route passes through alpine meadows and panoramic viewpoints. A picnic is organized by the lake with views of mountain peaks and crystal-clear water. After the hike, the group returns to the Artuch camp.
steps.city: Chimgan → Small Chimgan → Tashkent → Night train to Khiva
steps.alt: Chimgan → Small Chimgan → Tashkent → Night train to Khiva

steps.text: Arrival in Urgench and transfer to Khiva. The excursion begins in the ancient city and the Itchan Kala fortress. Visits include historical madrasahs, mosques, and mausoleums. In the evening, dinner and overnight stay in a family-run hotel.

After breakfast, transfer through the Kyzylkum Desert toward Bukhara. The road crosses one of the largest deserts in Central Asia. Stops for rest are possible along the way. Arrival and hotel check-in in Bukhara in the evening.

Sightseeing tour of Bukhara, including mausoleums, mosques, and the Ark Fortress. Continued walk through Lyabi-Hauz ensemble and trading domes. After lunch, further exploration of historical monuments. In the evening, dinner in a madrasah and free time.

steps.header: Bukhara → Chashma → Nuratau Mountains → Canyon Camp
steps.text: Early departure from Bukhara toward the Nuratau Mountains. Stops along the way include historical ruins and Silk Road wells. A 16 km trek begins with mule handlers. In the evening, setting up camp by the river and dinner under the stars.
steps.city: Bukhara → Chashma → Nuratau Mountains → Canyon Camp
steps.alt: Bukhara → Chashma → Nuratau Mountains → Canyon Camp

steps.text: Continuation of the multi-day trek through the Nuratau valleys. The route passes through villages and pastures with a traditional way of life. Along the way, encounters with shepherds and mountain settlements. In the evening, camp by a spring and rest.

Final stage of the mountain trek over a pass with panoramic views. After the descent, the group switches to transport. Drive toward the Kyzylkum Desert with a lunch stop en route. In the evening, accommodation in a yurt camp in the desert.

In the morning, a camel ride across the desert toward Aydarkul Lake. Rest and swimming at the lake with lunch on the shore. Afterward, return on foot to the camp through desert landscapes. In the evening, dinner in a yurt camp.

After breakfast in the desert camp, transfer to Samarkand. Upon arrival, introduction to the city and hotel check-in. Visit to Registan Square and the Gur-e-Amir Mausoleum. In the evening, shared dinner and free time.

Morning visit to the Shah-i-Zinda necropolis in the light of sunrise. Continue with the Bibi-Khanym Mosque and the local bazaar. Afterwards, further exploration of Registan Square. In the evening, dinner and rest in the city.
Free time in Samarkand for walking and shopping. Possible visits to craft workshops and cultural sites. After lunch, train ride to Tashkent. In the evening, farewell dinner in the capital.
Final day of the tour with transfer to the airport. If time allows, an additional walk in Tashkent. End of the program and departure of participants. The tour officially concludes.

Welcome to Kyrgyzstan with hotel check-in and time to rest after the flight. In the afternoon, a sightseeing walk around Bishkek is planned. In the evening, a welcome dinner at the hotel with a briefing about the route. This is a calm start to the journey with acclimatization.

After breakfast, departure toward Lake Song-Köl via the Burana Tower. Visiting the historical complex introduces the heritage of the Silk Road and the ancient city of Balasagun. The journey continues with a long drive into the mountains, gradually gaining altitude. In the evening, arrival and accommodation in a yurt camp on the lakeshore.

The day is dedicated to nomadic culture and active exploration. Participants go horseback riding along the shores of the lake or take scenic hikes. The route offers panoramic views of high-altitude pastures. In the evening, return to the yurt camp and rest.

After breakfast, departure from Song-Köl through mountain passes and valleys toward the Naryn River. Along the way, scenic high-altitude landscapes and nomadic settlements can be seen. The journey continues to the 15th-century Tash-Rabat caravanserai. In the evening, accommodation in a yurt camp and exploration of the historical site.

The day includes a horseback expedition to the Panda Pass area with views of Chatyr-Köl Lake. The route crosses high mountain valleys and the open Ak-Say plateau. A picnic is organized at the pass with panoramic scenery. In the evening, return to the Tash-Rabat camp.

A long drive over mountain passes with stops in scenic locations. Walks and a picnic in nature are included along the route. The journey passes through remote areas of the Naryn region. In the evening, arrival and accommodation in a guesthouse in Kazarman.

Departure from the mountain region via the Kaldama Pass with panoramic views. The road passes through gorges, rivers, and forested mountain slopes. Gradually, the route descends into the Fergana Valley. In the evening, arrival in Osh and hotel accommodation.

Crossing into Uzbekistan and starting the cultural sightseeing program. Visits to Andijan, Margilan, and a traditional silk factory. The route continues through Rishtan, known for its ceramics workshops. In the evening, arrival and accommodation in Kokand.

steps.header: Kokand → Tashkent → Night train to Khiva
steps.text: Transfer to Tashkent with a sightseeing tour of the old and new parts of the city. Visits include the Khast-Imam complex and Chorsu Bazaar. After the excursion, transfer to the train station for departure to Khiva. The night train journey concludes the day.
steps.city: Kokand → Tashkent → Night train to Khiva
steps.alt: Kokand → Tashkent → Night train to Khiva

steps.text: Arrival in Khiva and hotel check-in in the historic city center. Sightseeing tour of Itchan Kala fortress with visits to madrasahs, mosques, and mausoleums. After lunch, continuation of the exploration of palaces and historical complexes. Evening free time and dinner.

A long drive through the Kyzylkum Desert with stops along the way. The landscape features vast sandy plains and desert scenery. Upon arrival in Bukhara, hotel check-in and a walk through the old city. Dinner at a local restaurant in the evening.

A full-day sightseeing tour of Bukhara’s historical monuments. Visits include mausoleums, mosques, the Ark Fortress, and trading domes. After lunch, continuation of exploration of madrasahs and architectural ensembles. Evening free time and dinner.
Free morning followed by a train journey to Samarkand. Upon arrival, introduction to the city and its Timurid heritage. Evening walk and dinner. A transition day between two ancient capitals.

Sightseeing tour of Samarkand’s key landmarks. Visits include Registan Square, the Gur-e-Amir Mausoleum, and the Bibi-Khanym Mosque. The program also includes the bazaar and ancient archaeological sites. Evening dinner and free time.
After breakfast, departure to Tashkent by train or car. Upon arrival, short city tour and lunch. Free time before departure. Late-night transfer to the airport and end of the journey.

The journey begins with a drive from Osh to the high-altitude village of Sary-Mogol. Along the way, the Taldyk Pass offers panoramic views of valleys, pastures, and grazing yaks. After arrival, there is a short walk through the village and an introduction to the local way of life. In the evening, accommodation is provided in a guesthouse at an altitude of 3,000 meters.

steps.header: Sary-Mogol → Kashka-Suu → Valley of Yaks → Kosh-Kul Lake → Sary-Mogol
steps.text: This day is dedicated to an acclimatization hike in the Pamir Mountains. The route follows shepherd trails through the Valley of Yaks and past turquoise glacial lakes. From the highest point of the route, there are impressive views of Lenin Peak and the surrounding mountains. After the hike, the group returns to Sary-Mogol.
steps.city: Sary-Mogol → Kashka-Suu → Valley of Yaks → Kosh-Kul Lake → Sary-Mogol
steps.alt: Sary-Mogol → Kashka-Suu → Valley of Yaks → Kosh-Kul Lake → Sary-Mogol

steps.text: In the morning, the group sets out on a hike toward Traveler’s Pass. The trail offers spectacular views of glaciers, alpine valleys, and the majestic slopes of Lenin Peak. After reaching the viewpoint, the group returns to Tulpar-Kul Lake. In the evening, accommodation is provided in a traditional yurt camp.

The journey continues across the border from Kyrgyzstan into Tajikistan toward Lake Karakul. The landscapes gradually change into the harsh Pamir plateaus and glacial valleys. The route then crosses Ak-Baital Pass, one of the highest drivable passes in the region. In the evening, arrival in Murghab and accommodation in a guesthouse.

steps.header: Murghab → Alichur → Maljuran Valley → Mahan Peak
steps.text: After breakfast, the drive continues into the Maljuran Valley, surrounded by alpine lakes and mountain ranges. From here begins a hike to panoramic viewpoints and Mahan Peak. The route offers views of Yashilkul and Bulunkul lakes, as well as the Alichur Valley. After descending, the group relaxes in a yurt camp and enjoys the nearby hot springs.
steps.city: Murghab → Alichur → Maljuran Valley → Mahan Peak
steps.alt: Murghab → Alichur → Maljuran Valley → Mahan Peak

steps.header: Maljuran → Khargush Pass → Wakhan Valley → Langar
steps.text: The route crosses Khargush Pass and a panoramic ridge overlooking the Great Pamirs. During the hike, there are breathtaking views of the Afghan Wakhan Corridor and the Hindu Kush mountains. The road then follows the Pamir River into the Wakhan Valley. In the evening, arrival in Langar and accommodation in a guesthouse.
steps.city: Maljuran → Khargush Pass → Wakhan Valley → Langar
steps.alt: Maljuran → Khargush Pass → Wakhan Valley → Langar

steps.header: Langar → Yamchun Fortress → Bibi Fatima Hot Springs → Ishkashim → Khorog
steps.text: In the morning, the group visits Yamchun Fortress with panoramic views over the Wakhan Valley. The route then continues to the Bibi Fatima hot springs and historical sites of the region. After a stop in Ishkashim, the journey proceeds to Khorog. In the evening, there is a walk through the town and accommodation in a hotel.
steps.city: Langar → Yamchun Fortress → Bibi Fatima Hot Springs → Ishkashim → Khorog
steps.alt: Langar → Yamchun Fortress → Bibi Fatima Hot Springs → Ishkashim → Khorog

steps.text: The drive passes through remote Pamiri villages toward the Bartang Valley. From there, a hiking route begins to the lakes of Jizeu, surrounded by untouched wilderness. After arrival, the group settles into a guesthouse. In the evening, there is a walk around the lake and an introduction to the local culture.

In the morning, there is a walk to the second alpine lake. The group then returns to the vehicle and continues the journey along the Afghan border. The route passes through the Vanj Valley with its scenic mountain landscapes. In the evening, arrival in Kalai-Khumb and accommodation in a guesthouse.

The journey continues along the Panj River through deep gorges and mountain valleys. Along the way, stops are planned at Hulbuk Palace and scenic viewpoints. The road crosses Shurobod Pass and the Kulob region. In the evening, arrival in Dushanbe and accommodation in a hotel.

After a short tour of Dushanbe, the route heads toward the Fann Mountains. Along the way, there are views of rocky ridges and mountain passes. A stop is planned at Iskanderkul Lake for a short walk. In the evening, arrival in Artuch and accommodation in a guesthouse.

steps.header: Artuch → Kulikalon Lake → Bibijannat Lake → Panjakent
steps.text: The day begins with a hike to the alpine lakes of the Fann Mountains. The route passes through scenic valleys, juniper forests, and rocky mountain trails. Along the way, the group visits the turquoise Kulikalon and Bibijannat lakes surrounded by dramatic peaks. After the hike, transfer to Panjakent and accommodation in a guesthouse or hotel.
steps.city: Artuch → Kulikalon Lake → Bibijannat Lake → Panjakent
steps.alt: Artuch → Kulikalon Lake → Bibijannat Lake → Panjakent

steps.header: Osh → Taldyk Pass → Sary-Tash → Sary-Mogol → Tulpar-Kul Lake
steps.text: The journey begins with departure from Osh along the famous Pamir Highway. Along the way, the route crosses Taldyk Pass, offering panoramic views of mountains, alpine pastures, and yaks. After a stop in Sary-Tash, the group continues to Tulpar-Kul Lake near the base camp of Lenin Peak. In the evening, enjoy a walk by the lake, acclimatization, and an overnight stay in a yurt camp.
steps.city: Osh → Taldyk Pass → Sary-Tash → Sary-Mogol → Tulpar-Kul Lake
steps.alt: Osh → Taldyk Pass → Sary-Tash → Sary-Mogol → Tulpar-Kul Lake

steps.header: Tulpar-Kul → Traveller’s Pass → Bordobo → Karakul Lake
steps.text: In the morning, a trek begins to Traveller’s Pass with spectacular views of glaciers and Lenin Peak. After returning to the camp and having lunch, the group heads toward the Tajik border.
