The route continues through the Bordobo checkpoint to the high-altitude Karakul Lake. In the evening, accommodation is provided in a guesthouse on the lakeshore.
steps.city: Tulpar-Kul → Traveller’s Pass → Bordobo → Karakul Lake
steps.alt: Tulpar-Kul → Traveller’s Pass → Bordobo → Karakul Lake

steps.text: The journey continues through Ak-Baital Pass — the highest drivable mountain pass in Tajikistan. After a stop in Murghab, the route leads deeper into the highlands of the Pamirs. Along the way, there may be an opportunity to meet local nomads and enjoy a short yak ride. In the evening, arrival and accommodation in a guesthouse in Alichur.

steps.header: Alichur → Bulunkul → Kargush Pass → Wakhan Valley → Langar
steps.text: After breakfast, the group visits the high-altitude lakes Bulunkul and Yashilkul. The route then crosses Kargush Pass with a short hike to panoramic viewpoints overlooking the Great Pamir. After descending, the road follows the Afghan border through the Wakhan Valley. In the evening, accommodation in a guesthouse in the village of Langar.
steps.city: Alichur → Bulunkul → Kargush Pass → Wakhan Valley → Langar
steps.alt: Alichur → Bulunkul → Kargush Pass → Wakhan Valley → Langar

steps.text: The day begins with a visit to the ancient Yamchun Fortress and the Bibi Fatima hot springs. The journey then continues through the Wakhan Valley toward Ishkashim and Khorog. After lunch, the program includes visits to the museum, park, and botanical garden of Khorog. In the evening, dinner and overnight stay at a hotel.

The route follows the Panj River through scenic Pamir valleys. The road passes narrow mountain sections with panoramic views of the surrounding ranges. Along the way, there are views of the Afghan side of the border and dramatic river canyons. In the evening, arrival and accommodation in a guesthouse in Kalai-Khumb.

The final day follows the renovated road along the Panj River toward Dushanbe. Along the way, stops are planned at Hulbuk Palace and viewpoints overlooking the Nurek Dam. The route passes through deep gorges and mountain passes. In the evening, arrival in Dushanbe and the end of the journey.

steps.header: Osh → Taldyk Pass → Sary-Tash → Sary-Mogol → Tulpar-Kul Lake
steps.text: The journey begins with departure from Osh along the famous Pamir Highway. Along the way, the route crosses Taldyk Pass, offering panoramic views of mountains, alpine pastures, and yaks. After a stop in Sary-Tash, the group continues to Tulpar-Kul Lake near the base camp of Lenin Peak. In the evening, enjoy a walk by the lake, acclimatization, and an overnight stay in a yurt camp.
steps.city: Osh → Taldyk Pass → Sary-Tash → Sary-Mogol → Tulpar-Kul Lake
steps.alt: Osh → Taldyk Pass → Sary-Tash → Sary-Mogol → Tulpar-Kul Lake

steps.header: Tulpar-Kul → Traveller’s Pass → Bordobo → Karakul Lake
steps.text: In the morning, a trek begins to Traveller’s Pass with spectacular views of glaciers and Lenin Peak. After returning to the camp and having lunch, the group heads toward the Tajik border. The route continues through the Bordobo checkpoint to the high-altitude Karakul Lake. In the evening, accommodation is provided in a guesthouse on the lakeshore.
steps.city: Tulpar-Kul → Traveller’s Pass → Bordobo → Karakul Lake
steps.alt: Tulpar-Kul → Traveller’s Pass → Bordobo → Karakul Lake

steps.text: The journey continues through Ak-Baital Pass — the highest drivable mountain pass in Tajikistan. After a stop in Murghab, the route leads deeper into the highlands of the Pamirs. Along the way, there may be an opportunity to meet local nomads and enjoy a short yak ride. In the evening, arrival and accommodation in a guesthouse in Alichur.

steps.header: Alichur → Maldzhuran Valley → Makhan Peak → Maldzhuran
steps.text: The day is dedicated to hiking through the Maldzhuran Valley surrounded by alpine lakes and mountain panoramas. The route leads to scenic viewpoints and Makhan Peak at an altitude of 4,400 meters. From the summit, breathtaking views open over Yashilkul and Bulunkul lakes. After the hike, participants can relax in hot springs and spend the night in a yurt camp.
steps.city: Alichur → Maldzhuran Valley → Makhan Peak → Maldzhuran
steps.alt: Alichur → Maldzhuran Valley → Makhan Peak → Maldzhuran

steps.header: Maldzhuran → Kargush Pass → Wakhan Valley → Langar
steps.text: After breakfast, the route continues through Kargush Pass and panoramic trails of the Great Pamir. The group then descends toward the Afghan border along the Pamir River. Travelers will enjoy views of the Afghan Wakhan and caravans of Kyrgyz nomads. In the evening, arrival and accommodation in a guesthouse in the village of Langar.
steps.city: Maldzhuran → Kargush Pass → Wakhan Valley → Langar
steps.alt: Maldzhuran → Kargush Pass → Wakhan Valley → Langar

steps.text: In the morning, the group visits the ancient Yamchun Fortress with panoramic views over the Wakhan Valley. The route then continues through the Bibi Fatima hot springs and historical settlements of the region. After a stop in Ishkashim, the journey proceeds to the city of Khorog. In the evening, enjoy a walk through the botanical garden and overnight accommodation in a hotel or guesthouse.

The route heads toward the Bartang Valley, one of the most remote parts of the Pamirs. After the transfer, a hiking trek begins toward the village of Jizeu. The trail passes through wild mountain landscapes and dramatic gorges. In the evening, accommodation is provided with local families in the isolated village.

After breakfast, the group hikes back to the main road. The journey then continues along the Panj River with stops for photographs. Along the way, travelers will enjoy views of deep canyons and traditional Pamiri villages. In the evening, arrival and accommodation in a guesthouse in Kalai-Khumb.

The final day of the route follows the Panj River through the southern regions of Tajikistan. Along the way, stops are planned at Hulbuk Palace and panoramic viewpoints. The route crosses Shurobod Pass and scenic mountain valleys. In the evening, arrival in Dushanbe and the end of the journey.

The journey begins with departure from Dushanbe toward the Pamir Highway. Along the way, the group visits the 11th-century Hulbuk Palace and crosses the scenic Shurobod Pass. The route then descends to the Panj River, offering the first views of Afghanistan across the border. In the evening, arrival in Kalai-Khumb and accommodation in a guesthouse.

The route continues into the remote Bartang Valley, one of the wildest regions of the Pamirs. After a drive, a hiking trek begins toward the isolated village of Jizeu. The trail passes through rugged mountain landscapes and roadless gorges. The night is spent with a local family in a traditional Pamiri village.

The morning begins with the return hike from Jizeu to the main road. The journey then continues along the Pamir Highway toward Khorog. Along the way, stops are made for photography of dramatic mountain scenery and river valleys. In the evening, accommodation in a comfortable hotel in Khorog.

The route follows the famous Wakhan Corridor along the Panj River. The group visits Ishkashim, the ancient Yamchun Fortress, and the Bibi Fatima hot springs. Throughout the day, stunning views open over Afghan mountains and villages. In the evening, arrival in Langar and accommodation in a guesthouse.

This day is dedicated to a full-day trek to the meadows at the foot of Engels Peak. The route passes high-altitude valleys, alpine streams, and viewpoints overlooking the Hindu Kush. Along the way, travelers enjoy views of lakes and snow-covered Pamir peaks. After the hike, the group returns to Langar.

After departure from Langar, the route crosses Kargush Pass and enters the high-altitude regions of the Eastern Pamirs. Along the way, the group visits ancient petroglyphs and hikes along panoramic ridges. The journey continues to the lakes Bulunkul and Yashilkul. In the evening, arrival in Alichur and accommodation in a guesthouse.

The day begins with a drive across the high-altitude plateaus of the Eastern Pamirs. Along the way, the group passes Murghab and crosses Ak-Baital Pass at 4,655 meters. The route then descends to Karakul Lake, surrounded by stark and dramatic mountain landscapes. In the evening, a walk around the village and accommodation in a guesthouse by the lake.

Participants hike toward Ortoboz Pass at an altitude of over 5,000 meters. The trek passes alpine meadows and rocky slopes with panoramic views of the Pamir’s 7,000-meter peaks. After reaching the pass, the descent begins back to the vehicle. In the evening, return to Murghab and rest in a guesthouse.

The route returns along the famous M41 Highway — the Pamir Highway. Along the way, the group passes remote Pamiri villages and high mountain passes. Stops are made for photography and interaction with local communities. In the evening, arrival in Khorog and accommodation in a hotel.

After breakfast, the journey continues back along the Panj River. The route passes through scenic valleys and villages along the Afghan border. New perspectives of the Pamirs are revealed along the way. In the evening, arrival in Kalai-Khumb and accommodation in a guesthouse.

The final day includes the return to Dushanbe via the Panj River valley. The route crosses Shurobod Pass with stops in local villages and teahouses. The drive is accompanied by views of deep gorges and mountain rivers. Upon arrival in Dushanbe, the Pamir journey comes to an end.

The journey begins with crossing into Tajikistan and visiting the ancient city of Panjakent and the Sarazm archaeological site. After lunch, the route continues to the famous Seven Lakes, each with its own color and atmosphere. The road passes through the scenic mountain landscapes of the Fann Mountains. The night is spent in a guesthouse by the seventh lake.

steps.header: Seven Lakes → Panjakent → Artuch → Chukurak Lake
steps.text: After returning to Panjakent, the group visits the Rudaki Museum, dedicated to the famous Persian poet. The journey then continues to the Artuch base camp in the Fann Mountains. In the afternoon, a hike is made to the high-altitude Chukurak Lake. In the evening, rest at the base camp surrounded by mountain scenery.

steps.alt: Seven Lakes → Panjakent → Artuch → Chukurak Lake

steps.text: The day is dedicated to trekking to one of the most beautiful lakes in the Fann Mountains — Kulikalon Lake. The route passes through alpine meadows and panoramic viewpoints. A picnic is organized at the lake with views of the surrounding peaks and crystal-clear water. After the hike, the group returns to Artuch camp.

The drive passes through scenic mountain regions of Tajikistan to Iskanderkul Lake. Participants visit Snake Lake and the Iskanderkul Waterfall. After some time at the lake, the route continues to Dushanbe. In the evening, arrival and hotel check-in.

The journey along the famous Pamir Highway begins. Along the way, the group visits the 11th-century Hulbuk Palace and ascends into the Pamir Mountains via Shurobod Pass. The first views open onto the Panj River and Afghanistan on the opposite side. The night is spent in a guesthouse in Kalai-Khumb.

The route continues into the Bartang Valley, one of the most remote regions of the Pamirs. After the drive, a hiking trek begins to the isolated village of Jizeu. The trail passes through wild mountain landscapes and narrow gorges. The night is spent with a local family in a guesthouse.

In the morning, the group hikes back to the main road and continues toward Khorog. Stops are made along the way for photography of Pamir landscapes. After arrival, there is time for a walk in the city and a visit to the high-altitude botanical garden. In the evening, accommodation in a guesthouse or hotel.

The route follows the famous Wakhan Corridor along the Panj River. Along the way, the group visits Ishkashim fortress, the ancient Yamchun fortress, and the Bibi Fatima hot springs. The road offers continuous views of Afghan mountains and Pamiri villages. The night is spent in the village of Langar.

After visiting petroglyphs and an ancient fortress, the trek begins toward a panoramic ridge at 4,800 meters. From the summit, wide views open over the Wakhan Range and high-altitude lakes. The journey then continues to Bulunkul and Yashilkul lakes. In the evening, arrival in the village of Alichur.

The journey continues across the Eastern Pamirs to the Kyrgyz yurts of Bash-Gumbaz. Here, participants experience nomadic life and may ride yaks. After crossing Ak-Baital Pass, the route leads to the high-altitude Karakul Lake. Overnight stay in a guesthouse by the lake.

After crossing the Tajik–Kyrgyz border, the route continues into the Alay Valley. Along the way, views open over glaciers and Pamir peaks. After a stop in Sary-Mogul, the group arrives at Tulpar-Kul Lake at the foot of Lenin Peak. In the evening, accommodation in a yurt camp.

The day is dedicated to a hike to Traveler’s Pass at 4,130 meters. The route offers impressive views of Lenin Peak glaciers. After rest and photography, the group descends back to camp. In the afternoon, transfer to the village of Sary-Mogul.

steps.header: Sary-Mogul → Sary-Mogul Pass → Besh-Kol → Yurt Camp
steps.text: A multi-day trek continues through high mountain passes of the Pamirs. The route crosses scree slopes and glacier valleys toward Sary-Mogul Pass. From the top, panoramic views open over Besh-Kol lakes and surrounding peaks. Overnight stay in a yurt camp in the mountains.

steps.header: Yurt Camp → Kyzyl-Shoro → Kosh-Moinok Pass → Kosh-Moinok Valley
steps.text: The trail gradually descends through green valleys and pastures toward the village of Kyzyl-Shoro. Along the way, travelers pass shepherd yurts and mountain rivers. The ascent then begins toward Kosh-Moinok Pass. After crossing, the group descends into the valley and stays in a yurt camp.

steps.text: The final trek crosses Sary-Bel Pass with views over the Kichik-Alay Mountains. The route passes the striking red cliffs of the “Valley of the Three Dragons” and scenic gorges. After descent, the group arrives in Kojokelen village for lunch. The journey continues to Osh, where the trip concludes.

tourDetail.text: An experienced guide accompanies you throughout the entire route, ensuring safety, navigation, and an introduction to the local culture.

Yurts, grazing herds, and open horizons create a unique atmosphere of freedom, where nature and tradition exist in perfect harmony.

moments.header: Moldo-Ashuu Pass and Kazarman — a road through the mountains
moments.text: Moldo-Ashuu Pass captivates with its winding roads and scenic mountain views, revealing different faces of Kyrgyzstan. Along the way, you may see yurts scattered across green slopes. The road leads to the quiet village of Kazarman, where peace and simplicity define everyday life. This journey combines the beauty of the road with the warmth of local hospitality.

moments.header: Arslanbob — a world of walnut forests and tradition
moments.text: Arslanbob is a unique destination surrounded by the world’s largest natural walnut forests. Ancient traditions are still preserved and passed down through generations. The local community maintains a balanced and harmonious way of life. This is a place where nature and culture exist in a single living landscape.

Burana Tower is a remarkable historical monument located in the Chuy Valley near the town of Tokmok. Built in the 11th century, it is part of the ancient city of Balasagun — once a capital of the Karakhanid Khanate. Today, it remains one of the few surviving architectural testimonies of that era. The site offers a unique opportunity to connect with the region’s rich past and feel the spirit of the Silk Road.

Oguz-Bashi Peak is one of the most impressive summits of the Tien Shan, known for its dramatic alpine landscapes. Here you will encounter glaciers, steep rock faces, and snow-covered slopes that create a breathtaking mountain scenery. The area attracts adventurers and climbers from around the world. The ascent offers a true challenge and unforgettable emotions.

Song-Köl is a high-altitude alpine lake in the Tien Shan mountains, known for its silence and natural harmony. It is famous not only for its scenic beauty but also for the opportunity to experience Kyrgyz nomadic culture. Visitors can stay in traditional yurts and experience life on the summer pastures (jailoo). It is an ideal place to immerse yourself in authentic atmosphere and escape from modern civilization.

Kel-Suu is a hidden gem of Kyrgyzstan, located at an altitude of over 3,500 meters above sea level. The lake is famous for its crystal-clear water and dramatic cliffs surrounding it on all sides. Due to its remote location, it offers a feeling of complete silence and isolation. It is a perfect destination for those seeking untouched nature and truly unique landscapes.

A two-day horseback journey through the scenic surroundings of Song-Köl Lake. This is an opportunity to experience the freedom of nomadic life among endless high mountain pastures. You will stay in yurts and guesthouses while learning about the traditional lifestyle of local families. You will also discover how Kyrgyz nomads train golden eagles for hunting and preserve ancient traditions.

moments.header: Trekking in the Heart of the Tien Shan
moments.text: A four-day hiking adventure through the majestic Tien Shan mountains offers unforgettable panoramic views. The route passes through mountain valleys, high passes, and alpine meadows. The highlight of the journey is reaching Ala-Köl Lake — a striking turquoise jewel surrounded by rugged cliffs. This is a trip for those seeking true mountain adventure and the raw power of nature.

moments.text: A trek to the high-altitude Kel-Suu Lake — one of the most hidden and impressive places in Kyrgyzstan. It is located in a remote valley near the border with China. The journey passes through harsh yet breathtaking mountain landscapes. This destination amazes with its silence, vast scale, and a strong feeling of complete disconnection from civilization.

The journey begins in Kyrgyzstan with a visit to the scenic Song-Köl Lake and overnight stays in traditional yurts. Here, you can experience authentic nomadic life, see vast alpine pastures, and taste local cuisine. The route continues through the ancient caravanserai of Tash Rabat, immersing you in the atmosphere of the Great Silk Road. This stage combines nature, history, and a unique cultural experience.

moments.header: The Pamir Mountains and Lenin Peak Base Camp
moments.text: The route then leads to the foot of Lenin Peak — one of the most impressive summits in the region. Here, breathtaking views of high-altitude landscapes and glaciers unfold before you. Participants enjoy hiking and trekking activities that allow them to truly feel the scale and power of the Pamirs. It is an ideal destination for those seeking a genuine mountain adventure.

The adventure ends in Dushanbe, leaving unforgettable memories of a truly epic expedition.

Walking through the city, you will discover its many layers — from historic quarters to contemporary architectural landmarks.

Its narrow streets, madrasahs, and mosques preserve the spirit of thousands of years of history and caravan trade. Every stone here tells the story of the Great Silk Road, creating an atmosphere of an authentic Eastern journey.

Along the way, you will visit the famous Lake Karakul, the Wakhan Valley, and remote Pamiri villages.

Each day brings new landscapes, fresh mountain air, and unforgettable views.

Discover the beauty of the Fann Mountains, the turquoise lakes of Haftkul, and the majestic peaks of the Pamirs. This is a unique combination of active adventure, authentic culture, and the breathtaking landscapes of the Pamirs and Tien Shan.

infos.head: Туры по Шёлковому пути
infos.motto: Отправьтесь в одно из самых грандиозных автомобильных путешествий в мире
infos.firstText1stPart: Наши туры «Шелковый путь» предлагают разнообразные маршруты, позволяющие познакомиться с культурным и историческим ландшафтом Великий шелковый путь в Центральной Азии. Эти путешествия охватывают Кыргызстан, Узбекистан и Таджикистан, раскрывая богатое наследие, традиции и самобытную культуру региона.
infos.firstText2ndPart: В программу входят такие впечатления, как верховая езда, знакомство с кочевым образом жизни, гастрономические открытия и посещение легендарных городов — Хива, Бухара и Самарканд. Каждое путешествие продумано так, чтобы вы могли не только увидеть главные достопримечательности, но и глубже почувствовать атмосферу региона, его историю и живые традиции.
